title: P&G plans to cut manufacturing and logistics workforce by up to 30% by 2030
summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) plans to reduce its manufacturing and logistics workforce by 20 to 30 per cent by the end of the decade as it steps up cost-cutting efforts amid rising operating expenses and subdued consumer demand. Reportedly, the proposed reduction will cover both employees and contractors.
llm_summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) intends to shrink its manufacturing and logistics workforce by roughly 20‑30 % by 2030 as part of a sweeping cost‑cutting drive spurred by higher operating expenses and weak consumer demand. The reductions will affect both full‑time employees and contractors, reflecting a broader effort to streamline operations and improve profitability.
